audit.why: Spikes at Lvl 2 (W before Dazzle's telegraph lands), Lvl 6 (R out-ranges his engage and forces a defensive Cosmic Radiance), and 1st item (E-dodge cycle) are grounded in the kits — Taric's E has a real wind-up and his R is a delayed, reactive invuln, not a stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Cosmic Radiance as matchup-defining but has no digits anywhere, and never mentions Dazzle's cooldown, which is the actual dodge-window number.
audit.why: Cosmic Radiance (R) is 180/150/120 by rank. Dazzle (E) is 16/15/14/13/12 — its long wind-up (not the cooldown itself) is the dodge window content already describes.
audit.corrected: - Taric Cosmic Radiance cools 180/150/120s by rank — the delayed invuln erases your teamfight damage, so burst before it lands or wait it out. - Battle Dance (E) has no cooldown — hop freely. - Dazzle (E) is 16s at rank 1, down to 12s at 5; its long wind-up is your dodge window.

edits.before: - Taric Cosmic Radiance: matchup-defining — The delayed invulnerability erases your teamfight damage — burst before it lands or wait it out. It writes your spacing rules. - E Battle Dance is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Taric Cosmic Radiance cools 180/150/120s by rank — the delayed invuln erases your teamfight damage, so burst before it lands or wait it out. - Battle Dance (E) has no cooldown — hop freely. - Dazzle (E) is 16s at rank 1, down to 12s at 5; its long wind-up is your dodge window.

edits.before: Q the pair for the heal, W the window, E home — the trade paid twice and answered once.
edits.after: Chain Q into W right as Dazzle whiffs — its slow wind-up leaves nothing else to punish it.

edits.before: Entrancing into a banked disengage — the bird that flies into tornadoes writes the highlight for the other team.
edits.after: Battle Dance needs a return body — hop without one and you land stranded in his Dazzle wind-up range.
